subject: general
question: In a blend of apple juice and orange juice, 20% was apple juice. In another blend of the two juices, 30% was orange juice. The two blends are mixed in a certain ratio of apple juice and orange juice in the mix was 4 : 3. Find the ratio of the first blend and the second blend, in that order, in the final mix.
solution:
**Given : **

In first blend apple juice to orange juice ratio = 20% : 80 % = 1 : 4

In another blend apple juice to orange juice ratio = 70% : 30% = 7 : 3

In mixture ratio of apple juice to orange juice = 4 : 3

**Calculations : **

Let the ratio of the first and second blend be K : 1.

Then, according to question,

The ratio of apple juice to orange juice in the mixture 

⇒ (frac{1)/(5)K +(7)/(10)times{1}}{(4)/(5)K+(3)/(10)times{1}} = (4)/(3)

⇒ {(1)/(5)K + ((7)/(10)) × 1} × 3 = {((4)/(5))K + ((3)/(10)) × 1} × 4

⇒ ((3)/(5)K) - ((16)/(5)K) = ((12)/(10)) - ((21)/(10))

⇒ - ((13)/(5)K) = - ((9)/(10))

⇒ K = (9)/(26)

**Hence, the required ratio is 9 : 26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

Mixture (I) -

Quanity of Apple = 20% and quantity of Orange = 80%

So, Apple : orange = 20 : 80 = 1 : 4

Mixture (II) -

Quanity of Apple = 70% and quantity of Orange = 30%

So, Apple : orange = 70 : 30 = 7 : 3

In mixture ratio of apple juice to orange juice = 4 : 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5af35af34d49aadc60b9e8d2867a6caa8e513d1920e561f10d341ce5b97e0b92.png] 

Thus, required ratio 

⇒ 9/70 : 13/35

⇒ 9 : 26

**Hence, the required ratio is 9 : 26.**
